description: This file defines the ApiException class in the SuiteCRM API v8 exception namespace, extending LangException, with properties and methods for handling API error details and HTTP status.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for API errors in SuiteCRM, providing additional context and HTTP status handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ApiException with a message, code, previous exception, and optional LangText message.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Returns additional details about the exception, as a LangText object.

methods.name: setDetail
methods.description: Sets the detailed LangText message for the exception.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source of the error, either as a string or array.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Retrieves the source information of the error.

methods.name: getHttpStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with this exception (500).
